actions.action: Push a finger 3 cm into the soil to check moisture
Water thoroughly when the top 2–3 cm is dry, then empty the saucer after 15 minutes
Feel for warm rising air from a radiator or heater under the window
Check whether leaves touch the glass or are exposed to drafts
Group the calathea with other plants
Set the plant on a tray of wet pebbles
Move the plant 30–50 cm from the glass and out of heater airflow
